2609.35671.title: PhoneCLI: From App Interfaces to Callable Commands for Mobile Agents
2609.35671.paper_summary: Mobile GUI agents operate through a perception--action loop: at each step they screenshot the device, invoke a vision--language model (VLM), and emit an action. It is slow, costly, and brittle, yet most of what it does is navigation---and everyday navigation is static, ordered, and endlessly repeated. We present PhoneCLI, which compiles an app's GUI navigation into callable commands, without any app-internal API, runtime instrumentation, or model training. Offline, PhoneCLI explores a target app from the outside and distills its screens, interactive elements, and navigation edges into a semantically annotated map; each screen yields one deterministic command: a replay sequence that reaches it. Online, the agent selects a command, verifies it before execution, and then executes it deterministically in sub-second time at zero VLM cost; open-ended interaction and every failure of the compiled path fall back to the embedded VLM interpreter, exactly the pure VLM agent, so compilation can only help. On AndroidLab, PhoneCLI improves the task success rate while reducing steps and token consumption, and it transfers to AndroidWorld's official M3A agent with consistent efficiency gains. What PhoneCLI compiles is the app's navigation rather than one run, so it serves new tasks, not only repeated ones.
2609.35671.paper_summary_zh: 行動 GUI 代理透過感知--行動循環運作：在每一步中，它們截取設備的螢幕畫面，調用視覺--語言模型 (VLM)，並發出一個行動。這個過程緩慢、昂貴且脆弱，但它所做的大部分是導航——而日常導航是靜態的、有序的，並且不斷重複。我們提出了 PhoneCLI，它將應用程序的 GUI 導航編譯成可調用的命令，而無需任何應用內部 API、運行時儀器或模型訓練。在離線狀態下，PhoneCLI 從外部探索目標應用，並將其螢幕、互動元素和導航邊緣提煉成一個語義註釋的地圖；每個螢幕產生一個確定性的命令：一個到達它的重播序列。在在線狀態下，代理選擇一個命令，在執行前進行驗證，然後以亞秒的時間確定性地執行，且不產生 VLM 成本；開放式互動和編譯路徑的每一次失敗都回退到嵌入的 VLM 解釋器，完全是純粹的 VLM 代理，因此編譯只能提供幫助。在 AndroidLab 上，PhoneCLI 提高了任務成功率，同時減少了步驟和令牌消耗，並且在一致的效率增益下轉移到 AndroidWorld 的官方 M3A 代理。PhoneCLI 編譯的是應用的導航，而不是單次運行，因此它能夠服務新的任務，而不僅僅是重複的任務。
